body: Own markdown->Telegram HTML converter in crates/transcript (markdown.rs) instead of pulldown-cmark: tests/purity.rs pins transcript deps to serde, serde_json, unicode-segmentation; a line-based subset with recursive, always-closed tags is enough.

Op::Send/Op::Stream carry html: Option<String> next to the plain text; the scheduler (not the Transport) handles 400 can't parse entities by dropping html and putting the job back at the head of its lane, so the retry is metered and keeps topic order. Alternative rejected: second sendMessage inside BotApi::execute (unmetered).

Formatted: Stop answers and agent replies (shared send_text), streamed answers, stream Note text and thinking. Plain: prompts, tool lines, notices, buttons, permission prompts, subagent blocks, /brief and /full (their prompts and tool lines are not model markdown). A merged stream message with one formatted line becomes HTML with the plain lines escaped.

Extracting real answers from ~/.claude/projects jsonl for the converter fixture was denied by the permission classifier; used the real model-written maw/tasks/done/TASK-004/IMPL_SUMMARY.md from the repo instead.

Verdict PASS rather than NEEDS_WORK: backslash-escape eating Windows path separators outside code, link URLs with parentheses, repeated HTML merge on retry and tilde/'>' over-detection are minor rendering or bounded-retry issues; no invalid HTML, over-limit chunk or retry loop was found.

Backslash rule: it escapes only characters the converter reads as markup (\ ` * _ ~ [ ] # < >), and never inside a whitespace-delimited word that looks like a Windows path (has X:\ or a backslash before a letter/digit); there both chars stay as text and the next char is still not markup. So C:\dev\_x and \server\share stay as written while my\_var and \*x\* lose the backslash. Alternative rejected: 'not escape after an alphanumeric char' breaks my\_var and italic\*.

Bounded inline work with a per-line step budget (32 per byte + 1024) shared by all scans (closing, code_end, link, autolink) and the inline loop; when spent, the rest of the line is plain text. Alternative rejected: the review's 'remember no closer for this delimiter' memo, which leaves code_end inside closing, link and autolink quadratic.

A job resent plain after can't parse entities is marked plain_retry and merge_lines skips it entirely; lines already merged into it go with it. Alternative rejected: let it merge more lines as plain text, which would drop their formatting for no gain.

Fence opening is checked against closer lines of the whole message (precomputed offsets and suffix max of run length per marker), not the current chunk, because split_markdown_for_telegram renders slices and a block's closer can be in a later slice.
